name: The Murder Mass
source:
1988, USA, Missouri. Halloween.

FBI agent Samantha Winters arrives in the small town of Harvest Creek to investigate a series of ritualistic murders that have occurred every Halloween for the past few years, with identical killings spreading across the country. Her predecessor took his own life just days before, destroying all of the case files and leaving Samantha to start the investigation from scratch.

With the help of a Baptist pastor and a convicted occultist, she must uncover what is hiding behind the murders before Halloween claims a new victim…
